IDEA TITLE: गंतव्य (GANTAVYA)
SIH018
❖ Proposed Solution (Idea, Architecture & Novelty) PROBLEM STATEMENT ID: SIH018
1 Detailed Proposed Solution

3-Sided Closed Loop: Integrates Citizens, Municipal Admins, and Field Workers into a real-time synchronized platform.

  • 1-Tap Photo Capture: Auto-extracts hardware EXIF GPS & timestamp.
  • Multimodal Vision AI: Classifies defect, calculates severity (Grade 1–5), and flags spam under 1s.
  • Live Tracking: Real-time ticket progress with digital evidence receipts.
2 How it Solves SIH018 Gaps
  • Auto Department Routing: Automatically maps complaints to PWD, Jal Board, Sanitation, or Electrical based on AI vision classification.
  • Duplicate Merging Engine: DBSCAN spatial clustering (35m radius) + Image Cosine Similarity merges 50 complaints into 1 unified task.
  • Predictive SLA Escalation: Automated alerts escalate to Ward Officers if unresolved before SLA deadline.
3 Innovation & Uniqueness
  • AI Before vs After Check: Field workers must upload completion photo; AI verifies resolution before ticket closes.
  • Civic Gamification: Citizens earn Civic Coins & badges for verified reporting and neighbor upvoting.
  • Voice & Multilingual: Native Hindi/regional voice reporting for rural & non-tech savvy citizens.

FEASIBILITY, RISKS & MITIGATION
SIH018
❖ Feasibility Analysis, Challenges & Mitigation Strategies RISK ASSESSMENT
Feasibility Analysis
Technical Feasibility: Lightweight async FastAPI core with sub-50ms query time; fully functional working prototype already built and tested.
Financial Feasibility: 100% open-source foundation; cloud deployment costs < ₹0.02 per processed complaint.
Operational Feasibility: REST APIs plug directly into municipal Smart City ICCC dashboards without server overhauls.
Potential Challenges & Risks
1. Spam & Stock Photos: Malicious users submitting fake images downloaded from the web.
2. Offline Field Zones: Field workers operating in basements or network dead-spots.
3. Citizen Retention: Citizens abandoning reporting due to lack of feedback.
Strategies for Mitigation
Anti-Fraud Hardware Lock: Live camera capture with real-time EXIF GPS validation and Vision AI authenticity check.
Offline-First Radar Sync: IndexedDB caches tasks locally; background sync auto-reconciles on network recovery.
Civic Reward Incentives: Civic Coins, municipal utility bill discounts, and neighbor verification upvoting.
